seasonalProduce.name: Sindhri Mangoes
seasonalProduce.description: The quintessential summer treasure of Sindh. Incredibly aromatic, rich golden pulp, and low fiber content.
seasonalProduce.flavorNotes: Intensely sweet, floral aroma, melt-in-mouth texture

seasonalProduce.name: Anwar Ratol Mangoes
seasonalProduce.description: Compact in size with an intoxicating fragrance and miniature burst of honeyed sweetness.

seasonalProduce.name: Crisp Bitter Gourd (Karela)
seasonalProduce.description: Rich in antioxidants and minerals, summer bitter gourds are harvested young for crispy sautéing and stuffing.
seasonalProduce.flavorNotes: Distinctive herbal bitter flavor, crisp exterior

seasonalProduce.name: Organic Farm Spinach (Palak)
seasonalProduce.description: Lush dark green leaves bundled freshly from Malir farm belts. Packed with iron, calcium, and vitamins.

seasonalProduce.name: Desi Red Carrots (Gajar)
seasonalProduce.description: Deep crimson sweet local carrots, renowned across Pakistani winter markets for fresh juices, salads, and traditional halwa.

seasonalProduce.name: Garden Mint (Podina)
seasonalProduce.description: Hand-picked fragrant bunches, perfect for fresh raita, winter chutneys, hot teas, and detox drinks.

seasonalProduce.name: Tender Green Peas (Matar)
seasonalProduce.description: Sweet young pea pods freshly shelled at morning bazaar stalls, packed with plant protein.

seasonalProduce.name: Fresh Farm Strawberries
seasonalProduce.description: Sweet and tangy crimson berries cultivated around Sindh's southern farmlands, brought daily to urban weekend stalls.

seasonalProduce.name: Crisp Garden Cucumbers (Kheera)
seasonalProduce.description: Hydrating, thin-skinned field cucumbers, harvested early morning for superior crunch in seasonal salads.

seasonalProduce.name: Sweet White Guavas (Amrood)
seasonalProduce.description: Fragrant Sindh guavas with a crisp bite and aromatic soft center. Rich in vitamin C and dietary fiber.

seasonalProduce.name: Tender Bottle Gourd (Lauki)
seasonalProduce.description: Light, easily digestible autumn gourd cooked in curries or prepared into comforting lentil stews.
seasonalProduce.flavorNotes: Subtle, mildly sweet, soft spongy flesh

seasonalProduce.name: Vine-Ripened Tomatoes
seasonalProduce.description: Plump, red cooking and salad tomatoes continuously supplied from open fields and greenhouse tunnels across Sindh.

seasonalProduce.name: Fresh Crop Potatoes (Aloo)
seasonalProduce.description: Versatile all-purpose potatoes sourced from trusted growers, providing dependable kitchen foundations year-round.

seasonalProduce.name: Coastal Sindh Bananas
seasonalProduce.description: Sweet, naturally ripened bananas grown throughout the fertile lower Indus basin and coastal belts.

seasonalProduce.name: Traditional Fresh Yogurt (Dahi)
seasonalProduce.description: Farm-fresh cultured buffalo and cow milk yogurt, prepared daily by local dairy vendors in clay and steel pots.

seasonalProduce.name: Fiery Green Chilies (Hari Mirch)
seasonalProduce.description: Crisp green chilies in mild to intensely pungent varieties, essential for authentic Pakistani spice blends.
